nodes.summary: Creates an in-memory FastAPI TestClient for isolated API tests.

nodes.name: cli.py
nodes.summary: Process entry that starts a local uvicorn server for the FastAPI app on 127.0.0.1:8506 and injects a shutdown callback so the Studio UI can stop the process.
nodes.languageNotes: Binds uvicorn to 127.0.0.1:8506 (reload off) and passes shutdown_callback into create_app; the nested shutdown sets server.should_exit = True.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Constructs uvicorn.Server with create_app(shutdown_callback=shutdown) on port 8506 and runs it until the callback flags should_exit.

nodes.name: tsconfig.app.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript 5.9 application compiler options for the frontend src tree: ES2023 plus DOM, React JSX, bundler module resolution, and @/* path aliases into ./src. Enables unused-local/parameter and switch-fallthrough checks, verbatimModuleSyntax, erasableSyntaxOnly, and noEmit so Vite owns bundling.
nodes.languageNotes: TypeScript 5.9 bundler-mode config with verbatimModuleSyntax, erasableSyntaxOnly, and @/* aliases.

nodes.name: ollama_alive
nodes.summary: Reports whether the configured Ollama host responds so runtime health and adapters can degrade when local inference is offline.
